planning_notes: The request for 5 EASY targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available pool. To ensure non-redundancy and pedagogical variety, each target focuses on a different core mechanism (Context Switching, Collection Creation, Document Insertion, Collection Dropping, and General CRUD) and utilizes a distinct assessment facet (Concept Understanding, Code Interpretation, Output Prediction, Error Diagnosis, and Practical Application). This ensures broad coverage of the curriculum at the requested difficulty level.
